profile.reading: This record is named Cyxtera (Digital Realty Trust) Citibank Data Center in this registry, mapped to Weehawken, New Jersey, a name that already associates this facility with Digital Realty Trust and with a Citibank tenant relationship in the registry own pre-existing data. No corporate website could be reached for this operator this session, and no independent secondary source was found this session to confirm or contradict that existing name, so it is carried forward unchanged as existing registry data rather than independently verified this session, and address, capacity, and square footage remain not published in this record. Cyxtera Technologies, headquartered in Coral Gables, Florida, entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Brookfield Infrastructure, disclosed via an SEC Form 8-K titled "Cyxtera x Brookfield APA Press Release" and filed November 2, 2023, per SEC EDGAR's full-text search index; this registry has not independently confirmed the full scope of that transaction (whether it covered Cyxtera's entire US colocation portfolio or a subset), nor whether it touches this specific Weehawken facility or its pre-existing Digital Realty and Citibank associations. Separately, Cologix, a different operator tracked elsewhere in this registry, acquired two specific Cyxtera facilities, VAN5 in Vancouver and MTL12 in Montreal, in 2023, per Cologix's own materials; those two Canadian facilities are unrelated to this New Jersey facility and to the Brookfield transaction. Cyxtera's own public website resolves but displays content that reads as dated (referencing a 2017 executive appointment) with no current facility locations list, and its data-centers subpage returns a certificate error, a combination consistent with a company mid-transition following the Brookfield transaction rather than one actively maintaining public marketing infrastructure. No square footage, MW capacity, or current operational status specific to this Weehawken facility was located in sourcing reachable this session.
